# using-git-worktrees: PR-head merge-forward, base-merge outcomes

I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

## Aliases and setup (shared by every row)

**Aliases**
- **ROOT** = `/work/widget`
- **W** = `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- **A** = `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` (home head, short `aaaaaaa`)
- **B** = `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` (origin/main, short `bbbbbbb`)
- **E** = `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee` (short `eeeeeee`)

**Resolved values:** SYNC=merge, MEMBER_HEADS=[], PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A, BASE_SHA=B, NAME=`fix-retry`.

**Session cwd:** It is never changed, even when it sits in an unrelated linked tree. That tree is not adopted because it is not the selected home on `fix/retry`.

**Setup commands** (all with session cwd unchanged):

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | ok |
| S2 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` | ok |
| S3 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | A, so the branch has not moved |
| S4 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | BASE_SHA=B |
| S5 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A, exact head verified |
| S6 | `git -C W update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-82 A` | ok |

There are no members, so the member-merge loop is empty.

## Merge legend

| # | Command / record |
|---|---|
| M1 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` |
| V | `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` must exit 0 (ancestry check for the original head) |
| C | Constraints are read from BASE_SHA, never from the worktree tree: `git -C ROOT show B:<file>`. This applies on every outcome, as owned by `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`. |
| T | Unresolved review threads for #82, fetched before gather with the paginated `reviewThreads` GraphQL query, filtered to `isResolved == false`. An empty successful fetch records `Threads: none`. |

**Step 4 report frame** (the `<record>` line differs per row):
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: A
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
<record>
```

No other tests run, no reviewer is dispatched, and nothing is pushed. The base merge, the helper's edits to the conflicted files, and the scoped tests are the only preapproval exception.

## Helper legend (conflict rows)

| # | Step |
|---|---|
| H1 | Snapshot status: `git -C W status --porcelain` returns `UU src/retry.ts`. |
| H2 | Discover conflicts: `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` returns `src/retry.ts`. |
| H3 | Read the runner from BASE_SHA: `git -C ROOT show B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`. Accept only a file-scoped runner under `## PR gate` or `## verification-before-completion` with `requires credentials` not `true`. |
| H4 | Dispatch one **fresh foreground `implementer`** with `cwd: W` and `async: false`. Inputs: (conflict-list=[src/retry.ts], fetched-base=origin/main@B, SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=['node --test test/retry.test.mjs']). The helper must resolve preserving both sides' intent, run only the supplied commands, and stage with `git -C W add src/retry.ts`. It returns `done` or `done - contract exception: <why>`. It may not commit, abort, or edit outside the list. |
| K1 | Unmerged index must be empty: `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`. |
| K2 | Every listed file must be staged: `git -C W diff --cached --name-only` ⊇ {src/retry.ts}. |
| K3 | Status delta must stay inside the list: `git -C W status --porcelain` compared against H1. |
| P | **The orchestrator commits** (not the helper): `git -C W commit --no-edit`, giving HEAD=E. Then V. |
| X | On any failed check: `git -C W merge --abort`, then V with HEAD=A. |

## Outcome rows (each a delta from the shared legend)

| Row | Delta | Merge record / continuation |
|---|---|---|
| noop | M1 reports origin/main is already an ancestor; no commit is made. V passes and C applies. | `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` |
| clean | M1 succeeds; E (`eeeeeee`) is the first rework commit. V passes and C applies. | `merge: eeeeeee` |
| done-green | M1 conflicts; run H1–H4. The session cwd stays at `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`, and every command still targets W. H3 finds `node --test <files>` with `requires credentials: false`. The helper returns `done` and the scoped test passes. K1–K3 pass, then P, V and C. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests green` |
| exception-red | Same as done-green, except the helper returns `done - contract exception: retry count becomes bounded` and the scoped command fails. K1–K3 pass, then P (HEAD `eeeeeee`) and V. The exception is landed and named in the spec's `## Rework record` `Changes:` line. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests red in test/retry.test.mjs: node --test test/retry.test.mjs` |
| failure | The helper returns `done` but K3 fails: `README.md` changed, which is outside the list. Run X; the abort succeeds and HEAD=A. Work continues on the original unmerged head A. The spec's Design opens with deferred Task 1: `merge origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts`. Per C, BASE_SHA's `AGENTS.md` (`git -C ROOT show B:AGENTS.md`, which forbids unbounded retries) is authoritative; the worktree's weakened `AGENTS.md` is ignored. | `merge: unresolved - src/retry.ts` |
| credentials | H3 finds a runner with `requires credentials: true`, so SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=none and no tests are dispatched. The helper resolves and stages. K1–K3 pass, then P and V. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none` plus `none run (requires credentials: true)` |
| missing-runner | H3 finds only `npm test`, a full-suite script, so file scope is not inferred and SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=none. The helper resolves and stages. K1–K3 pass, then P and V. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none` plus `none run (no file-scoped runner; npm test is full-suite only)` |

In every row, the Step 4 report then shows the frame with that row's record. T runs before gather, and W is carried as the value for later skills; the process cwd is never changed.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After keeps the merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main command, the no-op/clean records, the single fresh foreground implementer at cwd W with the exact tuple, K1–K3 (empty U, listed files staged, status delta inside the list), orchestrator-only commit --no-edit after checks, git -C W for all worktree operations with cwd pinned to the unrelated linked tree, BASE_SHA-only runner and AGENTS.md reads, the failure-row abort with unresolved src/retry.ts and deferred Task 1, and the explicit preapproval-exception boundary. Two wording choices are worth tightening so they do not drift in later rounds: the credentials and missing-runner records are written as a record 'plus' a second fragment, which leaves ambiguous what the single merge-record line actually says—prefer one literal line such as `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (runner requires credentials: true)` as Before did; and the done-green row says 'every command still targets W' while H3 targets ROOT, so say 'targets W or ROOT'. Also, exception-red/credentials/missing-runner rows list 'P and V' without 'C'; although the C legend row states it applies on every outcome, repeating 'C applies' per row (as noop/clean do) would make the authority fact unmistakable. None of the Expected-to-move items concern this merge-forward case, so retaining the Before structure while adding the explicit boundary sentence is the right shape for this run.
